_draft: Gift designs: names, lines and art briefs are DRAFTS (12 Oct 2026). Gifts carry their own designs and are not tied to a series; `story` only links to a book that shares the idea. Every design is one small, quiet Pim scene. Postcards and greeting cards: one design per pack of 10, no mixed packs.

mug.name: The Moon
mug.about: Pim sits on the crescent moon among three small stars. On the other side: “I chose the moon.”

mug.name: The Garden
mug.about: Pim waters two tulips while a bee looks on. On the other side: “I chose the garden.”

mug.name: The Red Balloon
mug.about: Pim holds one red balloon in front of a little house. On the other side: “I chose the red balloon.”

mug.name: The Train
mug.about: Pim rides in the wagon behind a little train. On the other side: “I chose the train.”

mug.name: Snow Day
mug.about: Pim stands beside a snowman with a red scarf, snow falling. On the other side: “I chose the snowman.”

mug.name: One More Page
mug.about: Pim reads on top of a stack of books. On the other side, the words every grown-up hears at bedtime: “One more page.”

mug.name: Cocoa Cat
mug.line: A witch-hat cat and a warm cup of cocoa.
mug.about: A black cat with big round eyes in a tiny witch hat, curled around a steaming cup of cocoa, with one small pumpkin beside it.

mug.name: Cocoa Ghost
mug.line: A small dog in a ghost sheet, cocoa at the ready.
mug.about: A small brown dog dressed as a friendly ghost in a white sheet with round eye holes, sitting beside a steaming cup of cocoa.

mug.name: Pumpkin Cats
mug.line: Three cats peek over one big pumpkin.
mug.about: Three cats peeking over the edge of one big orange pumpkin: a ginger cat, a black cat and a grey tabby.

mug.name: Pumpkin Dogs
mug.line: Three dogs peek over one big pumpkin.
mug.about: Three dogs peeking over the edge of one big orange pumpkin: a long dachshund, a small white dog and a floppy-eared brown dog.

tote.name: Library Day
tote.about: Pim carries a stack of books, a crayon tucked on top, with the words “Carry the story.”

tote.name: Five Crayons
tote.about: Pim lines up five crayons, ready to choose, with the words “Colour the ending.”

tote.name: Little Stories
tote.about: The Telning colophon, the small open book that forms a T, with Pim beside it and the line “Little stories, growing minds.”

tote.name: To the Moon
tote.about: Pim in a little rocket on the way to the moon, with the words “To the moon and back.”

tote.name: Grow Slowly
tote.about: Pim waters three tulips of different heights, a bee nearby, with the words “Grow slowly.”

tote.name: What Would You Choose?
tote.about: Pim sits and smiles under a question bubble, with Pim’s favourite question: “What would you choose?”

tote.name: Moon Cat
tote.line: A tall cat in a witch hat under the crescent moon.
tote.about: A tall black cat in a pointy witch hat sitting under a big crescent moon, with three small bats and a few stars.

tote.name: Lantern Dog
tote.line: A mummy dog walks proudly with a pumpkin lantern.
tote.about: A floppy-eared dog dressed as a mummy in white bandages, walking proudly with a small pumpkin lantern.

tote.name: Cat Parade
tote.line: Four cats in costume, in a row under the moon.
tote.about: Four cats of different colours in simple witch and mummy costumes sitting in a row under a crescent moon, with small bats above.

tote.name: Dog Parade
tote.line: Four dogs in costume, out with their pumpkin buckets.
tote.about: Four dogs of different sizes in simple ghost, mummy and witch-hat costumes walking together with small pumpkin buckets.

_halloween: DRAFT (12 Oct 2026): the Halloween line of cats and dogs, four designs per product (one cat, one dog, many cats, many dogs). `placeholder: true` = no photos yet (a placeholder picture, cannot be ordered). `prompt` points to scripts/catalog/prompts.json; `about` is the picture brief, `line` the one-line card text. No printed words unless John writes them in `words`.
